steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Kaiser Wilhelm II became German Emperor (Kaiser) in June 1888 aged 29, following the death of his father Frederick III who had ruled for only 99 days. Wilhelm would reign until his abdication in November 1918. | Key Fact: Germany was a federal state with 25 states in 1871 (27 after 1912), each retaining its own ruler, government and laws. The Prussian King was automatically the German Kaiser. | Key Fact: Prussia was the largest and most powerful state in Germany. It covered 60% of German territory and contained 65% of the population. The King of Prussia was always the Kaiser. | Key Fact: Weltpolitik ("world policy") was Wilhelm II's aggressive foreign policy aiming to make Germany a major world power with colonies, a large navy, and international influence.
